handoffSay: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Kevin Cruz is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Kevin Cruz is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Anh blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Kevin Cruz, 14 days. The mantle passes to Anh Griffin.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Anh Griffin, 38 — a trail crew lead.
The village's quarrel was with Kevin — and Kevin is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
The fire knew Anh before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

📜 Kevin's book stays open on the table: one promise unkept — Donna — forage with Donna tomorrow to rebuild the pantry. The promises died with his maker; the needs didn't. What you do about them is yours to decide.
